title: fix(components): spec action entries stop forwarding an object params as values on non-api types (objectui#10462)
body:
Fixes #10462
Clause-②: no

## What this does

This finishes ruling A on objectui#10289 for the spec action-entry surfaces. Under that ruling, an action's `params` is only the `ActionParam[]` input list. Triage (comment `5827659739`) moves the non-`api` types now, and the `api` type keeps the objectstack#5777 window.

The four surfaces now route `params` the way PR objectui#10460 routes it on `action:button`:

| surface | array `params` | object `params`, non-`api` type | object `params`, `type: 'api'` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `element:button` inline `action` | `actionParams` (as before) | **not forwarded** + dev warning | unchanged |
| `action:group` items | `actionParams` (was `params`) | **not forwarded** + dev warning | unchanged |
| `action:menu` items | `actionParams` (was `params`) | **not forwarded** + dev warning | unchanged |
| `page:header` `dispatchHeaderAction`, with a record | `actionParams` (as before) | **not merged**; the `_rowRecord` stash stays | merged with the stash, as before |
| `page:header`, no record context | dispatched as authored (as before) | **dropped** + dev warning | dispatched as authored, as before |

- **One shared helper.** `readActionEntryParamValues` sits in `static-params.ts`, next to PR objectui#10460's `readStaticParamValues`, and all four sites call it. It uses the same warn-once memo and the same production gate. It is a separate function because a spec action entry has no `properties.params` bag, so the node helper's warning would send the author to a key this surface does not have. For `api` it returns the object unchanged. The runner still reads that object as the payload and prints its own objectstack#5777 warning, which names `bodyExtra`.
- **The `api` decision uses the dispatched type.** That is `action.actionType || action.type` on `element:button` (the value it forwards as `type`), `action.type` on the group and menu, and `type || actionType` on `page:header`, which is the runner's own order.
- **`page:header`'s stash is kept.** When there is a record, `params` is `{ _rowRecord }` for a non-`api` action. Only the authored object is left out. When there is no record context, the entry is still dispatched as authored, except that a non-`api` object `params` is removed. Without that, the no-record path would still pass the values through.
- **Why the array now goes to `actionParams` on the group and menu:** it mirrors `action:button`. The runner reads the collection list from `actionParams` or an array `params`, whichever is present, so param collection behaves as before. The forwarded-params pin in `action-forward-parity.test.tsx` stays green.
- `MetadataTypeActions.tsx` (app-shell) was measured and **left unchanged**. It rejects any `type` other than `api` with a toast before it reads `params`, and it does not go through the action runner (it builds and sends its own request). So it never forwards an object `params` on a non-`api` type. Its object read is the `api` arm, which this card does not touch.

## Reproduction (base `8740e86ce`, before the change)

The new pin file was committed first and run on the unchanged base: **10 failed / 9 passed (19)**. All five surface variants failed the non-`api` pin with `expected 'account' to be undefined`: the `navigate_edit` handler received the authored `objectName` / `recordId` as `ActionDef.params`. The group and menu array pins failed with `expected undefined to deeply equal [ { name: 'reason', … } ]`, because the list reached the runner under `params` and not `actionParams`. The `page:header` stash pin failed with `expected { objectName: 'account', …(2) } to deeply equal { _rowRecord: … }`. All five `api` controls passed.

## Tests

New pin file `packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/action-entry-object-params-10462.test.tsx` (19 tests). It runs over 5 surface variants (`element:button`, `action:group`, `action:menu`, `page:header` with and without a record). Each variant gets three pins: non-`api` object not forwarded plus one warning, array as `actionParams`, and the `api` control. The file adds two `page:header` stash pins (non-`api` drop, and the `api` merge control) and two warning pins (once per action across clicks; silent in production, values still dropped). After the change: **19 passed (19)**.

Union at the final head `1d8b74e83` (after merging `origin/main`), from the repo root:

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/src/renderers/` plus `page-header-actions`, `element-button-action`, `elementButtonActionMembers-8071`, `action-group`, `action-bodyShape-forward` and `scripts/__tests__/check-action-forward-parity.test.ts`: **132 files, 1323 passed, 10 skipped**.
- Full `packages/components/` on the pre-merge head `44b1d0c9a`: **302 files passed, 1 skipped; 2989 tests passed, 17 skipped**. The merge touched none of this change's files.
- `@object-ui/components` `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the new test file is in the second program, count 1 from `--listFilesOnly`): green at `1d8b74e83`, after building the dependency closure.

## Reverse verification (ablation)

Both legs were run through `ablation-replace.mjs` after the commit. The anchor was proven to land (1 to 0, blob changed), and the restore was proven on disk (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). The tests import the renderers by relative path, so the mutated source is what runs. The direction was predicted before each run.

1. `action:group`'s object branch reverted to a raw `params: action.params` forward: **2 red** (the group non-`api` pin and the warn-once pin), 17 green. Predicted: the array and `api` legs stay green.
2. `page:header`'s record branch reverted to merging `rawParams` into the stash: **2 red** (the header non-`api` pin and the stash pin), 17 green. The no-record variant stays green, as predicted.

## Gates run locally (at `1d8b74e83`)

Green: `check:action-forward-parity` (5 surfaces, 0 known gaps, every payload excess-property CHECKED), `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `changeset:check`, `check-changeset-presence` (1 changeset for 6 published source files). Before the merge the following were also green: `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:action-ref-convention`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:component-surface-parity`.

- ESLint on the 6 changed ts/tsx files (`--format json`): 6 files, 0 errors. The new lines add two `no-explicit-any` warnings, one each in group and menu, for `action.params as any` on the `actionParams` branch. This is the same cast `action:button` uses: `UIActionSchema`'s `ActionParam[]` does not assign to the runner's `ActionParamDef[]` (TS2322 without it, measured).
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 7 changed paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED locally: repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full `pnpm test`. CI runs them.

## Acceptance notes

- `@object-ui/app-shell` is not touched, so there is no app-shell changeset.
- Only metadata that skipped validation is affected: the spec already refuses an object `params` at the authoring door. PR objectui#10460's census found no in-repo JSON authoring the object form on an action node. This PR did not re-take that census for these entry surfaces.
- The `api` arm on these surfaces is still retired together with the objectstack#5777 removal at 18, as the card's direction says. Nothing here moves it.
